description: Reads the current 2016 Lean proof chain and source-refined exact integer matching functions, contrasts paper copied assignments with optimized f64 dummy-column/transposed production matching, and proposes composable functional, witness, representation and resource proof interfaces.

related_resources.reason: Pinned 2016 arXiv v4 and MFCS 2016 Section 3-4, Theorems 4 and 7, the exact source and local cost arguments.

learning_objectives: Classify which exact specification, rooted recurrence, executable baseline, matching helpers and cost pieces are already proved
Distinguish the paper copied perfect assignment from the production f64 dummy-column/transposed algorithm
Identify source, witness, numeric, Python, and asymptotic runtime interfaces still needed
Propose a bounded, composable sequence of new proof milestones without overclaiming formal source assurance
